questions.text: Which team do you support, and how did that allegiance get decided for you?
What sport or physical activity have you stuck with the longest?
What did you play seriously and then stop? Do you miss it?
What's the greatest sporting moment you've watched live, on TV or in person?
What's the worst teammate behaviour you've experienced in any sport?
What are you unreasonably competitive about that isn't a sport?
How's your fitness routine going, honestly? No judgement here.
What injury do you have a story and a scar for?
What sport would you try if there was no chance of embarrassing yourself?
What's the most obscure sport you'd happily watch a whole match of?
What actually gets you to move — a goal, a person, a playlist, or spite?
Were you on a team as a kid? Were you any good?
Do you enjoy watching or doing more? Has that flipped as you've got older?
Which athlete do you admire for something other than their results?
What rule would you change in a sport you follow, and what would it fix?
What's the best underdog story you've followed?
What's a personal best you're proud of, at any level?
What form of exercise do you absolutely refuse to do?
What's the most annoying thing people do at a gym, pitch, or pool?
What outdoor activity would you like to be good at?
What sporting event would you fly across the world to attend?
Are esports real sports? Give an actual argument, either way.
What did a coach say to you that you still repeat to yourself?
What's your most intense personal rivalry, in anything at all?
What's the worst you've ever lost at something, and how did you take it?
What have you actually won? Trophy, medal, pub quiz, doesn't matter.
Team sports or solo sports — which suits your temperament and why?
Do you have a match-day ritual, superstition, or seat you must sit in?
What physical thing would you like to be able to do a year from now?
What was the first live match or event you attended, and who took you?
Does your area have a team, club, or event that defines it?
What could you coach someone in, and what would your first lesson be?
